notes: EDI equals EAX (the record) as at the only call site 0x4976f, since untimed waypoints pass the stale EDI as the time. Record modes 1 and 2 only: other modes leave the shape byte uninitialised in the original. 0-4 flights with 0-5 or negative waypoint counts; owner rows -3..19. Stubs log their arguments (narrow arguments zero-extended); 0xcc1ac, 0xcc1ec, 0x38584 and 0x37498 return queued values; 0x37498 pops nine dwords and clobbers EBX ECX EDX, 0x385cc pops two.
